title: RangeNav: Task-Aligned LiDAR Range-Image Pretraining for Robot Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2610.29845v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous mobile robots operating in dense crowds and cluttered sites require $360^\circ$ perception to react to surrounding hazards. While panoramic LiDAR offers full-surround coverage, learning representations within reinforcement learning (RL) is sample-inefficient under sparse rewards, and existing 3D pretrained point-cloud encoders are too memory-heavy for massively parallel RL simulation. We present RangeNav, a compact (183k parameters) LiDAR range-image encoder pretrained entirely on synthetic data. RangeNav uses anisotropic convolutions and circular padding to handle the extreme aspect ratio and azimuthal seam of range images. We pretrain the network using a navigation-aligned objective combining range reconstruction, semantic segmentation, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) prediction, then freeze it for policy learning. translated_title: RangeNav：面向机器人导航的任务对齐激光雷达距离图像预训练
translated_abstract: 在密集人群和杂乱场所中运行的自主移动机器人需要360°感知能力以应对周围的危险。虽然全景激光雷达能够提供全方位覆盖，但在强化学习（RL）中学习表征在稀疏奖励下样本效率低下，且现有的3D预训练点云编码器对于大规模并行RL仿真而言内存开销过大。我们提出了RangeNav，这是一个紧凑型（18.3万参数）的激光雷达距离图像编码器，完全使用合成数据进行预训练。RangeNav采用各向异性卷积和循环填充来处理距离图像的极端长宽比和方位角接缝问题。我们使用结合距离重建、语义分割和鸟瞰图（BEV）预测的导航对齐目标对网络进行预训练，然后将其冻结用于策略学习。在仿真中，相比仅使用重建的基线，添加语义和BEV监督使成功率提升了（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出RangeNav，一个仅18.3万参数、完全基于合成数据预训练的轻量级激光雷达距离图像编码器，通过结合距离重建、语义分割和鸟瞰图预测的导航对齐目标，为大规模并行强化学习的机器人导航提供高效的360°感知表征。
en_tdlr: RangeNav is a compact 183k-parameter LiDAR range-image encoder pretrained entirely on synthetic data with a navigation-aligned objective combining range reconstruction, semantic segmentation, and BEV prediction, enabling efficient 360° perception for massively parallel RL-based robot navigation.
